description:
[Trading Data API] Free, no signup required — Free, no signup required. Upcoming US macro events (FOMC rate decisions, CPI, jobs report) with verified Fed/BLS dates, days-until, and Kalshi rate-decision odds (cut/hold/hike) for FOMC meetings.

**Example:** `/v1/macro-calendar`

days.description: Optional. Only events within the next N days.

type.description: Optional. Filter to FOMC, CPI, or NFP.

name: macro_calendar
